IGUI_AnomalousStormZombieSlowTooltip: Percent of normal speed from the start of the thunderstorm until rain ends. Default: 10.
IGUI_AnomalousStormZombieDamageTooltip: Health points in hundredths for exposed zombies and animals. 10 means 0.10 health every 10 minutes; 0 disables gradual damage. The lethal exposure point still applies.
IGUI_AnomalousStormMassDeath: The rain has killed all exposed zombies and animals in the area.
